prompt: When working for a not for profit 501c3 as a 10-99 contractor, is there any benefits to qualify for considerations or benefits to find a place to live, with low wages, not enough to afford rental, but too much to qualify for low income housing directly in Manatee County
response: As a 10-99 contractor, you may qualify for some low-income housing programs in Manatee County. Many not-for-profits offer housing assistance through their own programs, which can be a good way to find a place to live. It's a good idea to contact the not-for-profit directly to see if they offer any programs.
